items: PLATEAU STATE (PSI 9.4): Executes 17,603-Patient Free Medical Outreach with Zero Surgical Deaths & Launches Ward Facilitator Training for NFWP-SU
AKWA IBOM STATE (PSI 9.2): Clears ₦39.83Bn Bank Loans, Expands Marketable Securities to ₦47.2Bn & Saves ₦10Bn via Digital Payroll Reform
ENUGU STATE (PSI 9.0): Hosts 48th NCAB Meeting for $12Bn Agribusiness Target & Distributes 520 Grinding Machines Across 260 Wards
ONDO STATE (PSI 8.7): Gov. Aiyedatiwa Woos Upstream Energy Investors at NAPE 2026, Pledges Host Community Infrastructure & Security
OSUN STATE (PSI 8.5): Gov. Adeleke Partners UK on SPRIRET Digital Transformation & Clarifies $25.8M RAAMP Loan Repayment Maturity
FCT ABUJA (PSI 8.5): Wike Inspects Major Arterial Road Corridors & Pledges Imminent Opening of Abuja University of Science & Tech
LAGOS STATE (PSI 8.4): Commissions Reconstructed Abuja Governor's Lodge & Celebrates Cultural Economy at Lagos Gele Festival
ABIA STATE (PSI 8.2): Partners FDA & AGCC to Host AfriCANDO 2026 International Trade Forum in Umuahia
KANO STATE (PSI 8.1): Rehabilitates Tudun Wada Water Treatment Plant, Delivering 2.2 Million Litres Daily
EBONYI STATE (PSI 7.9): Gov. Nwifuru Congratulates Flamingos on U-17 World Cup Win, Highlights Abakaliki FC Investments
EDO STATE (PSI 7.8): Inaugurates SURWASH Technical Committee & Delivers Electricity Transformer to Egor LGA
KADUNA STATE (PSI 7.7): Earns PenCom Commendation, Ranking 4th Nationally in Contributory Pension Scheme Execution
BENUE STATE (PSI 7.6): Refutes NDC Disruption Allegations Concerning Peter Obi's Visit & Reaffirms Visitor Safety
OYO STATE (PSI 7.5): Presents ₦1.115Tn 2027 Appropriation Bill to Assembly & Nears Completion of 21.96km RAAMP Road
YOBE STATE (PSI 7.4): Ranks 2nd Nationally in Health Sector Budget Performance at 2026 JAR Programme
GOMBE STATE (PSI 7.3): Federal Fire Service Saves ₦20M Property in Hashidu Estate Residential Blaze
KOGI STATE (PSI 7.2): Performs Groundbreaking Ceremony for Kogi International Airport Construction

PLATEAU (PSI 9.4): Gov. Caleb Mutfwang's administration completed a 17,603-patient free medical outreach across 3 senatorial zones with zero surgical deaths (exceeding initial targets by 193%), while launching a 6-day Ward Facilitators training in Mangu LGA for the Nigeria for Women Programme Scale-Up.

AKWA IBOM (PSI 9.2): Gov. Umo Eno settled ₦39.831bn in inherited commercial bank loans, grew AKICORP marketable securities to ₦47.2bn, saved ₦10bn annually via digital payroll verification, paid ₦111bn in gratuities, and operationalized a 250-camera command center.

ENUGU (PSI 9.0): Gov. Peter Mbah hosted the 48th National Council on Agriculture, highlighting 187,000 hectares of secured land toward a $12bn agro economy, while distributing 520 grinding machines to vulnerable residents across 260 wards.

ONDO (PSI 8.7): Gov. Lucky Aiyedatiwa addressed NAPE 2026 in Lagos, inviting upstream petroleum and gas investors to Ondo State while highlighting its position as Nigeria's 5th largest oil producer, top security ratings, and host community infrastructure investments.

OSUN (PSI 8.5): Gov. Ademola Adeleke initiated the UK-funded SPRIRET digital economy partnership with British Deputy High Commissioner Jonny Baxter, while clarifying that DMO debt figures reflected inherited $25.8m RAAMP loan maturity rather than new borrowing.

FCT ABUJA (PSI 8.5): FCT Minister Nyesom Wike inspected Southern Parkway and ISEX 2 road projects, targeting 10 high-impact project inaugurations before Jan 2027, while assuring Abaji stakeholders of electricity restoration and the take-off of the FCT University of Science and Technology.

LAGOS (PSI 8.4): Gov. Babajide Sanwo-Olu and First Lady Oluremi Tinubu commissioned the reconstructed Lagos Governor's Lodge in Abuja; Lagos Ministry of Tourism hosted the Lagos Gele Festival in Lekki to drive creative enterprise and cultural tourism.

ABIA (PSI 8.2): Abia State Government announced the hosting of AfriCANDO 2026 in Umuahia (Nov 17–19) in collaboration with the Foundation for Democracy in Africa to advance US-Africa trade linkages under AGOA and AfCFTA frameworks.

KANO (PSI 8.1): Gov. Abba Kabir Yusuf's administration rehabilitated the Tudun Wada Water Treatment Plant, restoring clean water supply at 2.2m litres daily with plans to expand output to 4.5m litres daily for surrounding communities.

EBONYI (PSI 7.9): Gov. Francis Nwifuru congratulated Nigeria's Flamingos on winning the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup, advocating increased grassroots sports investments and highlighting state funding for Abakaliki Football Club.

EDO (PSI 7.8): Edo State Ministry of Water Resources inaugurated the SURWASH Technical Working Committee for World Bank project eligibility, while Egor LGA Chairman delivered a new transformer to Ekhator Street.

KADUNA (PSI 7.7): National Pension Commission (PenCom) commended Kaduna State for ranking 4th nationally in CPS implementation, praising consistent pension contribution remittances and accrued rights funding.

BENUE (PSI 7.6): Benue State Government dismissed allegations by the NDC governorship candidate regarding plans to disrupt Peter Obi's visit, assuring all visitors of safety, freedom of movement, and impartial law enforcement.

OYO (PSI 7.5): Gov. Seyi Makinde presented the ₦1.115 trillion 2027 'Budget of Sustained Progress' (60.07% capital allocation) to the House of Assembly and announced near-completion of the 21.96km Oloko Oyo Junction-Ikere RAAMP road.

YOBE (PSI 7.4): Yobe State was scored as the 2nd best state in health sector budget execution nationally at the 2026 Health Joint Annual Review in Abuja, reflecting Gov. Mai Mala Buni's priority on rural health facilities and workforce recruitment.

GOMBE (PSI 7.3): Federal Fire Service Gombe Command contained a residential fire at Hashidu Estate, saving property worth ₦20 million with zero casualties, and advised residents on electrical safety standards.
KOGI (PSI 7.2): Kogi State Government performed the official groundbreaking ceremony for the construction of the Kogi International Airport to expand regional air transport links.
